sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Unilateral headache ; reflex uterine, con-
gestive headache, better open air and by free flow.
Pain in eyeballs ; supra-orbital pains, photophobia. Nasal
catarrh, profuse, watery discharge. Loss of sense of
smell.

Gastric. — Desire for sweets, also acid things. Thirsty,
excessive nausea; obstinate constipation, hjemorrhoids.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Delayed and irregular menses ; menstrual
colic : amenorrhoea, pain in ovaries before flow ; menor-
rhagia, irritable bladder; leucorrheea.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Disturbed. Dreams of traveling.

^ck. — Pain along spine radiating to abdomen and
thighs.
